high_level_description: stc brand style, a professional photograph of a female wind energy technician measuring wind speed at a desert wind farm.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A desert wind farm landscape with multiple white-bladed wind turbines, rocky arid terrain in dusty pink and reddish-brown hues, and a soft purple-blue sky with scattered clouds.

elements.desc: A Middle Eastern woman wearing a bright yellow safety vest over a gray uniform, a white hard hat, and a black hijab, holding up a wind speed measurement device.
